content: Gold does not lose its luster when dropped in dirt; the noble soul does not lose virtue when surrounded by fools.
author: Kabir
explanation: True virtue is not a delicate perfume easily spoiled by toxic environments; it is an intrinsic brilliance that remains stainless regardless of surrounding corruption.
practicalInsight: Maintain your highest standard of kindness, honesty, and calm even if those around you are cynical or chaotic today.
reflectionPrompt: Does my integrity depend on good company, or is it sovereign from within?
